title: php.lang.security.audit.dynamic-call-user-func-wakeup
message: Semgrep detected dynamic callback execution via call_user_func($this->auditHook, $this->stagingPath) inside __wakeup() magic method of TempUploadStagingBuffer. If untrusted session or serialized data reaches session decoding (e.g., via PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS in CVE-2026-109618), an attacker can achieve arbitrary function invocation.

title: php.lang.security.audit.information-disclosure-error-get-last
message: Semgrep detected raw output of error_get_last() and worker_pid in JSON HTTP response. On persistent PHP-FPM workers affected by CVE-2026-109619, returning unredacted fatal error backtraces leaks cross-request memory state and sensitive arguments across tenant sessions.

title: dockerfile.security.missing-user.missing-user
message: By not specifying a USER instruction in the Dockerfile before CMD ["php-fpm", "-F"], the container master process defaults to running as root.

title: terraform.aws.security.iam.wildcard-resource-secretsmanager
message: IAM Policy statement 'ReadApplicationSecrets' grants 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue' on wildcard resource 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:000000000000:secret:genericcorp/prod/*'. Scope the ARN to the specific secret required.

title: terraform.aws.security.apigateway.unauthenticated-route
message: AWS API Gateway v2 route 'POST /upload.php' specifies authorization_type = "NONE", exposing the multipart upload endpoint to unauthenticated public traffic.
